![](images/profile.jpg){width=200px fig-alt="Professional photograph of Kevin Bachez"}


Welcome to my digital portfolio!

I am a marketing and analytics professional currently pursuing a Master of Science in Digital Marketing and Analytics at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona.

My professional background includes digital campaign management, social media marketing, marketing research, and data-driven strategy.

I am passionate about combining creativity with analytics to help organizations understand their audiences, improve engagement, and achieve measurable marketing results.

Through professional internships, academic projects, and teaching experience, I have developed skills in marketing analytics, digital strategy, and communication.

## Education

### California State Polytechnic University, Pomona

**Master of Science in Digital Marketing and Analytics**

Expected Graduation: 2027

### Biola University

**Bachelor of Science in Business Administration**

Graduated: May 2025

## Professional Experience

### Instructional Student Assistant
**California State Polytechnic University, Pomona | September 2026 – Present**

- Assist with grading and evaluating undergraduate marketing assignments.
- Provide feedback to students on marketing concepts and assignments.
- Support classroom activities and course administration.

### Marketing Intern
**Urban Youth Workers Institute | April 2025 – June 2025**

- Developed and executed digital marketing content strategies.
- Generated more than 74,000 views and 2,700 interactions.
- Contributed to gaining 338 new Instagram followers.
- Supported social media, email, and website marketing initiatives.

### Marketing Intern
**Biola University | August 2024 – May 2025**

- Increased Instagram followers by 17% over nine months.
- Generated more than 52,000 views and 1,300 interactions.
- Managed content calendars and digital marketing campaigns.
- Created marketing materials while maintaining brand consistency.

### Social Media Manager & Content Creator
**One Fresh Cookie Co. | September 2023 – January 2024**

- Created engaging digital content to support brand awareness and sales.
- Managed social media platforms with a combined audience of 1,500+.
- Increased follower count by 20%.

### Social Media Marketing Specialist
**University of California, Riverside | March 2023 – August 2023**

- Created digital promotional materials and marketing communications.
- Supported campus events and promotional campaigns.
- Managed social media accounts with more than 2,000 followers.

## Technical Skills

### Data Analytics and Visualization

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
- SQL
- R and RStudio
- Tableau
- Looker Studio
- Power BI
- Positron and Quarto

### Marketing and Research

- Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Marketing Performance Analysis
- Conversion Measurement
- KPI Development
- Qualtrics
- Survey Design
- Social Media Analytics
- Email Marketing

### Creative and Communication Tools

- Adobe Creative Suite
- Canva Pro
- Mailchimp
- Microsoft Office
- Google Workspace

## Featured Analytics Project

### Wellness Ranch Equine Assisted Therapy

As part of my graduate Culminating Experience Project, I am working on a digital marketing analytics initiative for Wellness Ranch Equine Assisted Therapy.

The project focuses on strengthening website performance, measuring user engagement, and improving conversion tracking.

**My primary contributions include:**

1. Developing a Google Analytics 4 measurement framework.
2. Identifying important website performance indicators.
3. Validating website engagement and lead-generation events.
4. Evaluating conversion measurement opportunities.
5. Supporting data-driven marketing recommendations.

[Explore My CEP Dashboard](dashboard.qmd)

## Marketing Research Experience

My academic research experience includes applying marketing research methodologies to examine consumer behavior and purchasing decisions.

I have worked with Qualtrics, survey design, analytical frameworks, and research reporting tools to support evidence-based marketing decisions.

## Career Aspirations

My professional goal is to advance in digital marketing and marketing analytics, helping organizations translate data into actionable marketing strategies.

I am also interested in higher education, particularly teaching marketing and potentially pursuing doctoral studies in the future.

## Connect With Me

**Email:** [kevinb.03@outlook.com](mailto:kevinb.03@outlook.com)

**Professional Portfolio:** [Visit My Portfolio](https://kevin-bachez.weebly.com/)

**Languages:** English and Spanish
